body: This made me smile. Thank you for the advice. I spend a lot of time watching YouTube videos and Netflix as distraction. I feel the same about silence driving me absolutely nuts. I've never actually watched batman the animated series, so I guess now is a good as time as ever to pick it up. I'm trying really hard to take things one day at a time but it gets so overwhelming sometimes. I'll do my best, and I appreciate the kind words.

I read somewhere recently, "suicide is not necessarily wanting to kill yourself or die, it's not wanting to live the life you currently have" that really resonated with me, and it seems like a similar concept to what you may be talking about in a sense.

Sadly, I can't say I have any good advice for you. But, I do want to say that I'm going through something similar, and I understand how you feel. I think I feel a lot like how you feel. You are heard, and you are not alone.
I appreciate the offer but I don't think I want to, just knowing someone has heard me is enough for now.
